title: FakeSourceSettings
description: Settings of the fake source, given under settings.fake-source in agentbay.config.yaml.

baseDate.description: The time the fixture posts lead up to: they are spread over the two weeks before it, so a fixed date gives the same posts on every run.

pageSize.description: The most posts one fetch returns; 10 when not given.

costPerItemUsd.description: The made-up price of one post in US dollars, reported as the cost of each page; 0.001 when not given.
